subject: storytime
title: The Dot words
about: Vashti is sure she cannot draw, until her teacher asks her to make one small mark on the paper and then sign it. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level, read it together, then let him make a dot of his own.

book.author: Peter H. Reynolds
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A short, gentle story about how one dot can be the start of making art.
